title: Weather widget
description:
Add a weather widget to the dashboard, similar to Dakboard/MagicMirror.

Requirements:
- Use Open-Meteo (free, no API key) for current conditions + 3-day forecast.
- Configurable location (lat/lon or city) and units (°C/°F) in Settings.
- Backend proxy endpoint (e.g. GET /api/weather) so the API key/rate limiting and caching live server-side; cache results ~10-15 min.
- Show current temp, condition icon, and a compact multi-day forecast in the UI.
- Graceful fallback when the weather API is unreachable.
- Timezone-aware daily grouping using the configured display timezone.

Acceptance: weather widget renders current + forecast for the configured location and refreshes automatically.

title: Wake lock: keep tablet screen awake
description:
Add a Screen Wake Lock API integration so the tablet/kitchen display does not sleep while the dashboard is open.

Requirements:
- Request a screen wake lock on load (navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')).
- Re-acquire the lock when the tab becomes visible again (visibilitychange) since browsers release it on tab hide.
- Handle the unsupported case gracefully (no-op if API unavailable).
- Provide a settings toggle to enable/disable wake lock (persist in settings).
- Show a subtle indicator when the lock is active/failed.
- Must require a secure context (HTTPS or localhost) — document this.

Acceptance: dashboard stays on indefinitely on supported browsers; no errors when unsupported.
